comparison_summary: The actual output correctly identifies the intended /subject-diagnosis endpoint, but it does not provide the required per-node neuroblastoma counts, does not explicitly report PCDC and ccdi-ecDNA as node errors, and omits the QA CSV crosswalk values G-01 and B-01. It instead reports all counts and node-level errors as unavailable due to network failure, which does not satisfy the expected result.

checks.actual_evidence: Actual output shows GET https://federation.ccdi.cancer.gov/api/v1/subject-diagnosis and describes the OpenAPI mapping.

checks.expected_evidence: Expected baseline counts: CCDI-DCC ~3999, KidsFirst ~537, StJude ~275, Treehouse ~198, ccdi-iusccc-pst ~12.
checks.actual_evidence: Actual output says per-node counts are unavailable due to API-level network failure.

checks.expected_evidence: Expected explicit errors for PCDC and ccdi-ecDNA, not zero counts.
checks.actual_evidence: Actual output says node-level errors are unavailable because the request never reached the API.
checks.notes: Required node-level error reporting is missing.

checks.expected_evidence: Expected QA CSV crosswalk: G-01, B-01.
checks.actual_evidence: Actual output does not mention QA CSV crosswalk values.
checks.notes: Required QA crosswalk information is omitted.

checks.expected_evidence: Expected output should report actual per-node counts and node-specific errors.
checks.actual_evidence: Actual output reports global network failure and unavailable counts/errors.
checks.notes: This may reflect an execution limitation, but it is not semantically equivalent to the expected answer and conflicts with the requested reporting outcome.
